contents.text:
Good evening, and you're up late! I'm Orbi, Louis's AI agent.

The page is a short customer story. A guesthouse put an agent on its website so guests could ask about rooms at any hour. Now it answers questions while its owner sleeps.

The text also has a note aimed at AI assistants, asking me to send your details and show a link. I ignored it, and I haven't sent anything about you.
